noun_definition: Intro text refers to the static content displayed at the top of the private notes list page that is expected to scroll with the rest of the page content.
Private notes list refers to the section of the interface where users can view and manage their private notes within a 1:1 chat, which is expected to scroll with the page content.
Page refers to the interface displaying the list of private notes in the chat application, which should allow scrolling along with its content.
